title: Scout Capability Manifest
description: Machine-checkable contract for the Capability Manifest /scout:setup writes to a repo's .claude/scout/capability-manifest.md (v0.3). Binds abstract capability names to a repo's real surfaces, maps audience tiers onto repo roles, and lists existing investigation skills + investigator agents. v0.3 adds an optional richer per-capability auth: {style, env?}, back-compatible with the bare auth_env string.

auth_env.description: Env var NAME only; value never read (INV-5). Back-compat shorthand for auth: {style: env, env: <NAME>}.

auth.description: Auth-style modeling (v0.3). Richer optional form; back-compatible with the bare auth_env shorthand. 'caller-token' = uses the invoking user's own token/creds; 'env' = an env var (name in `env`, value never read, INV-5); 'tenant-config' = resolved from per-tenant config at run time.

env.description: Env var NAME only (used when style=env); value never read (INV-5).

production.description: Touches a production data store? Rails treat a non-allowlisted prod query as forbidden.

ambient.description: Ambient toolbox flag (v0.4). Default-interpreted true inside investigation_toolbox[] (the tool is implicitly available to every investigation/step without re-declaration); n/a (ignored) inside capabilities[]. When true, the tool resolves for any step/agent that needs it AND may still be named explicitly in request.capability; every resolution still passes the rails and emits a DecisionRecord.

investigation_toolbox.description: The ambient shared capability layer (v0.4). Optional. Common investigation tools (app-logs, db-read, traces, mcp, per-repo other) available to EVERY investigation and every step/agent WITHOUT re-declaration in a playbook. Each entry has the SAME shape as a capabilities[] item (shared $defs/capabilityItem) plus the optional `ambient` flag (default-interpreted true here). Resolution is capabilities[]-first, then investigation_toolbox[] — a request.capability resolves against the union of both. Every resolution, ambient or explicit, still passes the rails and emits a DecisionRecord; tiering/redaction/production markers apply identically. Absent section = identical v0.3 behavior (backward compatible).

approval_tiers.description: Which tiers may confirm a needs-approval step. Never business.

investigators.description: Role -> agent map for orchestrated/freewheel investigation. A role with no agent is inert.
